differences.what: Cabinet frame edges and the top rail read as crisp dark lines in A; in B they wash out to a flat grey, so the box loses its outline and looks foggy
Internal shelf and the gap behind the woofer disc have deeper shadow in A, giving the inside depth; B lifts them to a milky grey with low contrast
B's front glass shifts to a darker, more saturated blue toward the lower half, which gives a richer coloured-glass read than A's paler, even tint
B has a stray horizontal light streak on the right side panel that reads as an artefact
Backdrop at the top is brighter and cleaner in A; B's upper backdrop is a duller mid grey, so the horn separates less from the set
